title: Search overlay accessibility candidate verified locally
summary: Corrected touch focus fallback and completed mobile/desktop validation against a successful production build. Not deployed; separate approval required.

changes.detail: Complete modal focus lifecycle: input focus, dynamic Tab/Shift+Tab trap, Escape from all controls, background/late-portal isolation, trigger return including touch fallback, responsive input transfer, hidden-exit inertness, original overflow priority/inert restoration.

Isolated test evidence, source inventory and certification. No other application files changed; Header, ProductGallery, search API/routing/style/French content and all prior production fixes preserved.

validation.name: Exact source and build
validation.detail: READY baseline/rollback dpl_8wg4bKgDpwtRDpvo1TZ5rCdkowNk; 2055 source files, only SearchOverlay differs. Candidate d2b2638c95f1c3e1082762084391bd170bf632afd337ab683065dd9b4d095050. Corrected build/types/lint exit 0; existing image lint warning only.

validation.name: Browser accessibility and functionality
validation.detail: 59 checks at 320/375/390/1440; real public API responses, suggestions, results, controlled loading/empty/error states, keyboard result activation, touch scroll, menu handoff, breakpoint focus, Escape, original inert/overflow restoration and focused axe. Supplemental touch close/backdrop/hidden exclusion passed, zero page/unexpected console errors; expected isolated-service console warnings recorded.

validation.name: Environment and manual limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or human screen-reader test. Local search API returns 500 with intentionally disconnected loopback database. Public API GET responses used only in browser harness; loading/empty/error states and navigation probes are browser-only. No mocks or credentials in candidate. Result-link Enter activation, exact href and close behavior checked with navigation prevented in harness; input ArrowDown/Enter routing checked against browser-only document probe. No local end-to-end database-backed product navigation. Existing focused image lint warning retained; full build also reports pre-existing warnings in unchanged files; no dependencies, CSS, API, product catalogue, payment, database or configuration changes.
